messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High GPU queue depth on cluster-gamma (>95th pct). 500+ pending requests. Autoscaler unable to provision more nodes (scale_limit_reached).

maria (oncall): seeing massive tail latency, multiple customer errors 503. paging now.

kelly (sre): joining. which autoscaler? GKE or internal? any recent deploys?

raj (eng-runtime): this is internal autoscaler for Dedicated pools (gamma). root cause looks like driver crashes on some nodes — repeated CUDA Xid and OOMs over last 20m. effective GPU capacity down ~35%.

dina (support): have already flagged top 5 customers experiencing throttles. ETA to get public-facing note?

maria (oncall): quick status: traffic steady, queue keeps growing. autoscaler logs show "scale_limit_reached" + "allocation timed out". many nodes are 'NotReady' then flapping back.

raj (eng-runtime): logs from one node: ```
[2024-11-12T08:14:21Z] nvml: GPU 0 Xid 31
[2024-11-12T08:14:21Z] runtime: process killed by signal SIGSEGV
[2024-11-12T08:14:22Z] kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 4123 (inferenced) total-vm:122G
```

kelly (sre): thanks. looks like driver/runtime instability + pod OOMs. Could be a workload regression or quantization change. Any deploys in the last hour?

raj (eng-runtime): no user-facing model deploys. We rolled a runtime kernel tweak last night to push tensor core kernels — rolling back might help.

maria (oncall): immediate mitigation plan proposals?

kelly (sre): 1) Temporarily mark affected nodes unschedulable and cordon to avoid further flaps. 2) Force autoscaler to ignore scale_limit for next 30m (if possible) to spawn fresh nodes in another AZ. 3) Route high-priority customers to fallback smaller model variant to reduce memory pressure.

raj (eng-runtime): +1. I'll trigger a targeted restart of inference driver on flaky nodes and revert the kernel tweak on a canary node. If that works, escalate to cluster-wide rollback.

dina (support): I'll open a soft incident banner for the impacted customers and offer retries. Draft: "We're investigating increased latency and throttling on Dedicated clusters. We're routing your requests to fallback models where possible." Want to post in 30m if we still see impact.

incident-bot: @maria oncall handoff scheduled in 25 minutes to @kelly.

maria (oncall): handoff accepted. I'll stay on until @kelly fully takes over after the rollback attempt. raj, please paste the driver restart command you will run.

raj (eng-runtime): restart command I'm using on node node-gamma-12: ```
kubectl -n redwood-system exec -it inference-driver-12 -- bash -c "supervisorctl restart inferenced && tail -n 200 /var/log/inferenced.log"
``` Running now on canary node.

deploy-bot: deploy redwood/runtime-kernel-revert v2024.11.12-rollback started (canary -> 1/10).

raj (eng-runtime): canary logs: post-restart, NVML errors stop for ~4m, memory pressure drops. canary now handling traffic.

kelly (sre): good. approve widening rollback. I'll bump autoscaler temp limit and spin up 5 fresh nodes in a different AZ. Also adding a temporary rate-limit per-tenant to reduce queue buildup: `--per-tenant-qps=2` for affected cluster.

maria (oncall): metrics: queue depth falling from 520 -> 140 in 18m. p95 latency improving. some nodes still flapping but overall capacity improving.

dina (support): posting initial status update to customers now.

raj (eng-runtime): continuing to monitor driver logs for Xid codes; will open a follow-up ticket to debug memory leak. collecting core dumps from the killed pods.

kelly (sre): next steps: 1) full rollback complete (in progress), 2) autoscaler limit revert after 60m if stable, 3) ATO to disable the kernel tweak across all Dedicated pools pending repro. assign to @raj for root cause.

maria (oncall): handoff to @kelly now. I'm available if things regrow.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Mitigation in progress — queue reduced ~75%. Customer impact reduced. Incident severity downgraded to SEV-2.

kelly (sre): marking incident as active but recovering. I'll coordinate postmortem and invite runtime + infra.

raj (eng-runtime): saving logs and core-dumps to s3://redwood-incidents/1729001123/ . opening incident ticket INC-2024-4027 with notes.

dina (support): follow-up message scheduled in 2 hours with an ETA for a formal postmortem.

maria (oncall): thanks team. closing my oncall handoff.

kelly (sre): thanks all. I'll keep thread updated as we collect RCA info.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: closed for oncall maria -> active for kelly (handoff recorded).
